# Harbor Lights Coffee: a short history

Harbor Lights Coffee was founded by Rosa Alvarez in Portland, Maine, in 2014, roasting on a single 5 kg drum in a
rented bay on Commercial Street. The first wholesale account, the Eastern Promenade Hotel, signed in March 2015.
In June 2017 the company opened its first cafe, on Exchange Street, managed by Daniel Okafor.

The roastery moved to Austin, Texas, in 2019 after the Portland lease ended; Priya Raman joined that autumn to run
the Mountain region from Denver. By Q4 2021 Harbor Lights had 48 employees and 180 wholesale accounts.

In February 2023 the company launched its subscription plan, Lighthouse, and the FY23 review (June 2023) counted
63 employees across the roastery, two cafes and the field team. The board approved the night-shift wellness program
in Q1 2024 after the memo from Rosa Alvarez on sleep consultations.
